INSTANTPILL-PHD.title: PHD
INSTANTPILL-PHD.description:
When obtained, add 2 [gold]Hearts[/gold] and 1 random [gold]Pill[/gold] to your [gold]deck[/gold].
You can identify all [gold]Pills[/gold].
[gold]Pills[/gold] have friendlier effects.
INSTANTPILL-FALSE_PHD.title: False PHD
INSTANTPILL-FALSE_PHD.description:
When obtained, add 1 random [gold]Pill[/gold] to your deck.
You can identify all [gold]Pills[/gold].
[gold]Pills[/gold] have more wicked effects.
For each [gold]Pill[/gold] with a powerful effect you play, gain 1 [gold]Strength[/gold], 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold], and 1 [gold]Focus[/gold] at the start of each combat.
